newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light at $103.50/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light at $103.50/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis; few dressed basis steady, USDA said. Demand and seller interest was modest.
Weekly volume 70,000. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 103.50. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 103.50.
Sales confirmed - 400 For the week - None.
